measurement_definitions.first_output_ms: client-observed first non-whitespace answer or parsed tool delta; not server TTFT
measurement_definitions.generation_tokens_per_second: (answer tokens - 1) / seconds between first and last answer chunk; estimate
measurement_definitions.aggregate: valid completions or known output tokens / seconds from first dispatch to last completion within each scenario; includes errors in window
measurement_definitions.workload_sizes: character sizing is requested shape; server token usage is observed length
measurement_definitions.warmup: initial and warm short requests only when required by selected checks or restart readiness; fairness and recovery use their own matched baselines

checks.title: Network and access
checks.summary: Configured route accepted requests; TLS trust is enforced for HTTPS.

checks.title: Serving success
checks.summary: Valid non-empty responses and required stream termination observed.

checks.title: First useful output
checks.summary: Timing observed; no acceptance limit configured. To conclude, set limits.first_output_ms to your service's acceptance target and rerun.

checks.title: Generation pace
checks.summary: Timing observed; no acceptance limit configured. To conclude, set limits.latency_ms or limits.stream_gap_ms or limits.min_output_tokens_per_second to your service's acceptance target and rerun.

checks.title: Arrival traffic capacity
checks.summary: The full rate plan needs more delivered, scored or timely evidence. To conclude, allow traffic.duration_seconds of at least 5 seconds per rate for at least 5 scored completions; set limits.first_output_ms or limits.latency_ms, enable stream/token measurements, and allow the whole rate plan to finish. Raise max_requests (or --max-requests) above 160 if exhausted, or select fewer checks. The plan needs at least 138 fixed requests; adaptive traffic may need more.

reasons: Set a first-output or total-latency limit to establish capacity.

metrics.scope: Highest tested incoming rate for this scored canary mix; internal server queue time is unobserved.

checks.title: Concurrent workloads
checks.summary: Scenario results: Input/output size and concurrency matrix: pass; Mixed workload interference: inconclusive; Streaming fairness: inconclusive; Token stress cases: inconclusive. Mixed workload interference: Mixed workload requires concurrency of at least two. To conclude, inspect the failed request and coverage details, correct the reported server or workload issue, then rerun the same workload.

size_matrix.title: Input/output size and concurrency matrix
size_matrix.summary: Bounded workload observed; untested combinations remain unverified.

mixed_interference.title: Mixed workload interference
mixed_interference.summary: Mixed workload requires concurrency of at least two. To conclude, inspect the failed request and coverage details, correct the reported server or workload issue, then rerun the same workload.

streaming_fairness.title: Streaming fairness
streaming_fairness.summary: Requires observable streaming and concurrency of at least two. To conclude, set --concurrency 2 or more, then rerun fairness.

token_stress.title: Token stress cases
token_stress.summary: long_input_summary: inconclusive — Token stress case was not reached within the shared run budget.; short_input_long_output: inconclusive — Token stress case was not reached within the shared run budget. To conclude, Raise max_requests (or --max-requests) above 160 if exhausted, or select fewer checks. The plan needs at least 138 fixed requests; adaptive traffic may need more. Allow more max_duration_seconds (or --max-duration) if the run deadline stops traffic.

long_input_summary.title: 10,000 input / 50 output summary
coverage_gaps: Token stress case was not reached within the shared run budget.

short_input_long_output.title: Short input / 10,000 output generation
coverage_gaps: Token stress case was not reached within the shared run budget.

checks.title: Long-context behavior
checks.summary: Built-in deterministic checks passed for the recorded fixtures.

calibration.method: builtin_fixtures(config with this fixture_context_limit); actual coverage uses returned usage

checks.title: Known-answer correctness
checks.summary: Built-in deterministic checks passed for the recorded fixtures.

checks.title: Limits and cancellation
checks.summary: Server stopped: unverified; answer check: pass. Client cancellation, output limits and prompt follow-up probes observed; server work cancellation is unverified.

client_deadline_self_test.scope: Exercises Giraffe's own client timer; nothing deadline-related reaches the server, so it is not endpoint evidence.

answer.title: Cancellation — verify answer
answer.summary: Completed stop/follow-up answers are scored separately; interrupted partial outputs are not graded.

checks.title: Sustained load and recovery
checks.summary: Recovery observed; no acceptance limit configured. To conclude, set limits.recovery_max_ratio or limits.first_output_ms or limits.latency_ms or limits.stream_gap_ms or limits.min_output_tokens_per_second to your service's acceptance target and rerun.

sustained_budget.policy: reserve fixed later work and probes; half quota cap only with later checks

checks.title: GPU observations
checks.summary: GPU end scrape did not return fresh device samples; the observation window is incomplete. To conclude, collect at least 6 complete scored answers per tested condition; check the fixture's expected answer and evaluator errors, increase the output budget for truncated answers, then rerun.
